memos.argument: Inductive loops and axle sensors are electronic detectors; 9030 covers instruments for measuring or checking electrical quantities. An inductive loop works by sensing inductance change, so arguably measures an electrical quantity (inductance); counting output would be 'other'. Weak: the goal is counting vehicles, not measuring an electrical quantity. cross_search returned no relevant rulings for this product (only unrelated 1990 HQ items), so no ruling is cited.
exclusions_against: Heading text limited to measuring/checking electrical quantities or ionizing radiation; vehicle/axle counting is not an electrical quantity
Chapter 90 note 1(h) and 1(g) do not exclude directly, but chapter 90 requires a measuring/checking instrument, not a mere sensor/detector
Section XVI note 1(m) confirms chapter 90 articles are outside chapter 85, no help here

memos.argument: 9031 is the residual heading for measuring or checking instruments, appliances and machines not specified elsewhere in chapter 90. Traffic counting sensors that detect and count vehicles/axles are measuring/checking appliances of the kind (counting traffic volume), classifiable under 9031.80.80 as other instruments. Chapter 90 note 2(a)/(b) support parts/accessories of such instruments. Strongest if sold with a counter/recorder; bare loops may be only parts/accessories (9031.90) or wire. cross_search returned no relevant rulings for this product (only unrelated 1990 HQ items), so no ruling is cited.
exclusions_against: If merely wire loop without electronics, may be classified as insulated wire (8544) or as parts
Pure detectors that only switch without measuring may fall to 8536 or 8543
Heading 9031 only for items not covered by a more specific heading such as 9030

memos.argument: Axle sensors and loops act as electrical switches/proximity sensors that close or open a circuit when a vehicle passes, fitting 'other switches' (8536.50) or 'other apparatus' (8536.90.85) for voltage not exceeding 1,000 V. Works if goods are simple sensor/switch devices without counting/recording function. cross_search returned no relevant rulings for this product (only unrelated 1990 HQ items), so no ruling is cited.
exclusions_against: 8536 covers apparatus for switching, protecting or connecting circuits; a detector that senses vehicles and outputs a signal is not clearly one
Plan notes unclear whether the sensors measure; if they measure, chapter 90 controls (Section XVI note 1(m) excludes chapter 90 articles from chapter 85)
